system.description:
Orcs don’t merely cut trees down, they uproot them entirely. Using labor and ropes, Orc Woodcutters clear the forests until only tortured ground remains—all the wood is taken to the furnace.

Obstacles: Bush, Ob 1. Sapling, Ob 2. Young tree, Ob 3. Mature tree, Ob 5. Ripe old redwood, Ob 8. Ancient magic tree, Ob 10.

Skill Type: Peasant. Tools: Yes, expendable rope and goblins.

Restrictions: Orcs only

Root: Hatred (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Book root includes Hatred, which the system cannot use as a root; Will is used instead.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 305
